title: Holding the Pen Against Heaven
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji's rewriting succeeded, a colossal eye that could blot out the sky slowly opened in the void—it was an existence surpassing the Heavenly Eye, more ancient and terrifying.

text.content: The golden characters on the fifth page of the Tianji Record clung to Su Qingyao's consciousness like vines. She finally saw the truth buried beneath countless years—their fates with Chen Nian had been woven into the same inescapable deadly game the moment Chen Ji obtained the Tianji Record.

However, just as Su Qingyao's consciousness was being shattered by the truth, Chen Ji's spiritual sense slashed like a drawn sword, severing the resonance with the fifth page prophecy. He couldn't let her see more—those truths about Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, and the sacrifice, she wasn't ready to know yet.

dialogue.content: (Spiritual transmission, icy calm) "Qingyao, listen to me. Close your eyes. Don't look anymore. Leave the rest to me."

text.content: At the center of the sacrifice formation, Chen Ji's physical body had been burned nearly charred by the golden text, but his spiritual sense was clearer than ever. The Writer's Authority—the trump card the Tianji Record granted him, ever since he obtained it he had never truly used it, because every time he invoked it, it meant the price of personally manipulating the threads of fate.

But at this moment, he had no choice. The core content of the fifth page prophecy emerged clearly in his consciousness—"Chen Ji, sacrifice to awaken, rebirth to destroy." These eight characters were the final ending the Heavenly Eye wove for him: either die in the sacrifice, or be completely reduced to a pawn of heaven's way under the name of rebirth.

dialogue.content: (Heavenly Eye, roaring will) "Mere ant, you dare spy upon the authority of writing? For ten thousand years, no piece has ever dared to染指 the rules—today, you shall pay the price for this!"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's voice did not come from outside, but rang directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That pressure was like mountains collapsing. Countless golden chains emerged from the void, wildly wrapping around the Tianji Record Fragment. The awakening of the Writer's Authority had even made this ancient existence feel threatened.

Chen Ji sensed the familiar Heavenly Law气息 on those chains, yet the corner of his mouth slowly curved into a smile. Shackle power—this was precisely what the sacrifice formation wanted to剥离 from him. But what the Heavenly Eye didn't know was that he had long since refined these shackles into part of himself.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's pressure, Chen Ji was about to invoke the Writer's Authority to rewrite fate. Before setting pen to paper, he had to decide how to rewrite it:

choices.description: Directly modify the core laws of the sacrifice formation, invalidating his own sacrifice while retaining the possibility of drawing power from the formation. This is the safest but also the most mediocre choice.
choices.visible_cost: May consume massive Heavenly Fate Value, possibly triggering formation collapse
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a brief safe window period
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may immediately detect and intervene

text.content: Chen Ji's spiritual sense touched the core laws of the sacrifice formation. Countless intricate formation patterns unfolded before his eyes. He saw the rules—those sacrifice contracts written by the Heavenly Eye itself, inviolable.

choices.description: Write a rewrite symbol on the fifth page prophecy, changing his death prophecy to "rebirth." This is the most radical and dangerous attempt, directly challenging heaven's writing rights over fate.
choices.visible_cost: May anger higher existences, fate backlash intensifies
choices.visible_reward: Completely reverse the certain-death ending, obtain complete Heavenly Secrets perception
choices.risk_hint: There may be a more terrifying existence behind the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji's spiritual sense rushed toward the fifth page prophecy without hesitation. The pages of the Tianji Record expanded infinitely in his consciousness. The golden prophetic text writhed like a living thing, emanating irresistible Heavenly Law pressure.

choices.description: Directly write new Heavenly Laws on the Tianji Record, using shackle power to counter shackle power, rewriting the foundation of ten thousand years of sacrifice rules. This is the craziest choice with the lowest success rate, but once successful, the benefits are incalculable.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high Heavenly Fate Value consumption, may be counterattacked by Heavenly Laws
choices.visible_reward: Obtain permanent rewrite rights over sacrifice laws
choices.risk_hint: This is truly a heaven-defying act, consequences are unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze pierced through the fifth page prophecy, looking toward the deeper source of laws. The foundation of the sacrifice formation, the Heavenly Eye's authority, the framework of rules accumulated over ten thousand years—all clearly visible before him like textures.

However, at this moment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently. Countless sealed knowledge flooded out like a tide—that was the true usage of the Writer's Authority—not to repair, not to fine-tune, but to completely overturn and rewrite.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng, remnant soul hoarse) "Chen Ji, you must understand—every rewrite by the Writer is etching your own mark onto the laws of the heavens. The Heavenly Eye can sense your movements, it won't give you the chance to complete the rewrite!"

text.content: Before the words finished, the sacrifice formation suddenly reversed. The golden chains originally wrapping toward Chen Ji abruptly tightened, piercing directly into his spiritual sense—the Heavenly Eye's counterattack. It intended to use the most brutal method to completely erase him before he could complete the rewrite.

dialogue.content: (Heavenly Eye, hellish pressure) "A mere ant dares to hold the pen against heaven? This one has gazed upon you all for ten thousand years—no one, no existence has ever been able to rewrite the fate this one has written!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt the excruciating pain of chains piercing his spiritual sense, yet there was not a trace of panic. He had waited for this moment too long—ever since the day he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been waiting for an opportunity to completely detonate the shackle power.

choice.prompt: The moment chains pierced his spiritual sense, Chen Ji felt unprecedented pain, but also sensed the resonance between shackle power and the sacrifice formation. At this moment he had to decide how to break the situation:

choices.text: Detonate the Shackles, Counterattack the Formation
choices.description: Detonate all the accumulated shackle power within him at once, destroying the core of the sacrifice formation at the cost of his own destruction. This is a mutual destruction tactic, but it can severely wound the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Spiritual sense severely wounded, may lose part of memory and perception
choices.visible_reward: Sacrifice formation temporarily disabled, buying crucial time
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may have long prepared defenses

text.content: Shackle power was brewing like a volcano within Chen Ji—that power accumulated from the moment he was deemed worthless. Countless dismissive glances, countless words of humiliation, countless moments treated as an ant—now all transformed into the purest destructive force.

choices.text: Borrow Force to Strike, Turn the Tables
choices.description: Using the connection from the piercing chains, reverse-extract the Heavenly Eye's power to complete the rewrite. This is the smartest tactic, but it means directly clashing spiritual souls with the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: May be corroded by the Heavenly Eye's spiritual soul
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's spiritual soul is far more powerful than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji allowed the chains to pierce his spiritual sense without the slightest resistance. He actively opened his Mental Sea, letting those golden chains deeply embed into the depths of his consciousness—then, he struck.

choices.description: Through the Tianji Record's connection, call Ye Qing in the Demonic Path Holy Sect, letting her mask his aura with Demonic Path mist, while having Su Qingyao share the Heavenly Fate Value consumption through their shared-life connection. This is the highest success rate but also the most dependent on others choice.
choices.visible_cost: Expose connections with allies, may implicate them
choices.visible_reward: Obtain allies' power support, greatly reducing rewrite risk

text.content: Chen Ji's spiritual sense pierced through the void, sending that never-before-used connection to Ye Qing far away in the Demonic Path Holy Sect. At the same time, the faint thread of fate between him and Su Qingyao was violently trembling.

At this moment, the sacrifice formation produced unprecedented violent tremors. The Heavenly Eye sensed Chen Ji's intention. For the first time, an emotion called "astonishment" appeared in its ancient unchanging will—it saw the first symbol slowly emerging on the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Heavenly Eye, furious) "That is... a rewrite symbol?! Impossible! The Writer's Authority is merely a fragmented piece, how could you—"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He simply gazed calmly at the gradually forming symbol—a simple stroke to the extreme—a curve to the left, symbolizing return to the source. This was the first rewrite symbol he self-created, combining knowledge unsealed from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul with his own understanding of shackle power.

The moment the symbol completed, the sacrifice formation's operation suddenly halted. Those golden chains began visibly disintegrating at a rate visible to the naked eye, transforming into countless light points flowing back into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The Heavenly Eye's pressure at this moment briefly vacuumed—a gap in the rules no one had touched in ten thousand years.

choice.prompt: The moment the rule gap appeared, Chen Ji obtained an extremely brief action window. This was his only chance to complete the final rewrite:

choices.description: Overwrite "rebirth" on the death prophecy, completing the core goal with the simplest rewrite. This is a conservative but effective choice, sufficient to free him from the certain-death situation.
choices.visible_cost: Can only reverse personal fate, cannot change the overall situation
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape the shadow of the death prophecy
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will quickly regain control

text.content: Chen Ji's spiritual sense transformed into a illusory pen, falling without hesitation on the fifth page prophecy. The "death" character about to be completed began to distort and melt under his rewrite, replaced by a brand new character—"life."

choices.description: Write a brand new sacrifice law in the rule gap, replacing the Heavenly Eye's will with his own. This is the truly heaven-defying move. Once successful, he will no longer be a piece, but a new chess player.
choices.visible_cost: May suffer full counterattack from Heavenly Laws
choices.visible_reward: Obtain permanent rewrite rights over sacrifice laws, become the new rule maker
choices.risk_hint: There may be higher existences behind the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze passed beyond the fifth page prophecy, casting toward the deeper source of laws. There lay the foundation of the sacrifice formation, the source of all sacrifices over ten thousand years. He was about to etch his own mark there.

choices.text: Write Chen Nian's Name, Recall the Heavenly Fate Lock Key
choices.description: Write his sister Chen Nian's name in the rule gap, breaking the Holy Sect's control over the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. This is his most desired goal, but it also means completely exposing his most fatal weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Expose weakness, may put Chen Nian in greater danger
choices.visible_reward: Break the seal on the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, bring Chen Nian back
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will exploit this

text.content: Chen Ji's spiritual sense touched that long-sealed name—Chen Nian. His missing sister for years, his closest kin taken by the Holy Sect as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. He had never forgotten her. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, all his stratagems had been preparing for today.

When the first rewrite symbol truly took shape, the entire sacrifice formation collapsed like a giant beast stripped of its skeleton. Golden light points scattered like meteors, dyeing the sky for a thousand miles into a dazzling galaxy. The Heavenly Eye's pressure completely dissipated at this moment, replaced by an indescribable emptiness.

Chen Ji felt the new power surging within him. This was no longer the fragmented Writer's Authority, but a complete Heavenly Secrets perception tempered by his own hands, bearing his personal will's imprint. He could feel every page of the Tianji Record, every law, every sealed secret—they opened their full gates to him for the first time.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji, spiritual sense calm) "I originally wanted to keep a low profile, playing the fool to reach the peak step by step. Unfortunately, there are always some self-important things forcing me to reveal my true form."

text.content: The moment the words fell, the Heavenly Eye emitted a roar that shattered the heavens. It felt its authority being usurped by an ant, felt the rules unchanged for ten thousand years being rewritten by a废物. This was unforgivable blasphemy, a monstrous crime that must be repaid with blood and soul!

However, just as the Heavenly Eye prepared to counterattack with all its might, an instant of stagnation appeared in the void. That stagnation lasted only the length of a breath, yet it was enough for Chen Ji to complete his rewrite—because he saw, behind the massive will projection of the Heavenly Eye, a pair of eyes slowly opening.

dialogue.content: (Heavenly Eye, terrified) "No—Master, please calm your anger! I... I can handle it! How could a mere ant be worth the Master's personal—"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's voice cut off abruptly. Because those eyes had fully opened. They were eyes impossible to describe—no pupil, no white, only a void abyss. It wasn't gazing at Chen Ji, but at the entire sacrifice formation, the entire Tianji Record, the entire rewritten framework of rules.

Chen Ji felt that gaze. Just the gaze alone caused his spiritual sense to throb with cracking pain. That was an existence surpassing the Heavenly Eye, the true幕后黑手 of all worlds. He had spent eight entire scrolls planning, scheming, enduring—all to wait for this moment, only to discover he had merely summoned the true ultimate BOSS.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji, smile still hanging at the corner of his mouth) "So that's how it is. There's a Master behind the Heavenly Eye? Interesting. It seems this ant has truly struck gold today."

text.content: Those Abyssal Eyes did not respond to Chen Ji's provocation, simply watching him silently. That gaze held no emotion whatsoever, yet it made Chen Ji feel a pressure ten thousand times more terrifying than all the Heavenly Eye's pressure combined. This was not anger, not contempt—merely simple "gazing"—like humans gazing at ants, neither angry nor happy.

At this moment, Chen Ji sensed a familiar power fluctuation approaching from afar—that was Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist, crossing through layers of void toward him. At the same time, Su Qingyao's consciousness also awakened from the chaos. Her first words were not terror, but a terrifyingly calm statement: "Chen Ji, the explanations you owe me—you can start talking now."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji, spiritual sense with a hint of exhaustion) "Explanations? Of course. But now isn't the time to talk—because we, it seems, have a much bigger trouble."

text.content: The Abyssal Eyes' gaze lasted three breaths, then it made an unexpected action—it closed its eyes. Not from contempt, but because... it deemed Chen Ji unworthy of its personal intervention. The Heavenly Eye trembled as it retook control, that pressure increasing by more than a hundredfold.

Chen Ji stood at the center of the collapsed sacrifice formation, surrounded by the rule halo he personally rewrote. He had finally completed the transformation from piece to chess player, yet also summoned the true mastermind behind the scenes. The secret of ten thousand years of sacrifices, the truth of Chen Nian's disappearance, the complete truth of the Tianji Record—all of this will gradually be revealed in the battles ahead. And for now, he only needs to remember one thing: those Abyssal Eyes will inevitably open again.
